headline: Tanzania Seeks Private Sector Funding for $24 Billion of National Plan
summary: Tanzania's national plan costs $33.8 billion, with the government seeking private firms to fund $23.6 billion amid lawmaker questions on readiness.
why: Large-scale public-private partnership infrastructure financing models determine capital deployment and private sector participation in East African economies.

impacts.name: Tanzania
impacts.why: Heavy reliance on private capital affects execution of national development goals.
